description: Timezone convert an ISO-8601 timestamp with Z or numeric UTC offset into an IANA timezone such as America/New_York, Europe/London or Asia/Tokyo. Returns UTC and local wall-clock representations with the target offset. Costs $0.001 USDC on Base via x402.

datetime.description: ISO-8601 instant including Z or an explicit +HH:MM/-HH:MM offset.

name: timezone-convert
